rationale: The workflow runs pip installs (gymnasium extras plus torch/seaborn/matplotlib/pandas/tqdm) on every job with no dependency cache, so repeated dependency fetching is measurable and pyproject.toml provides a stable cache input. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-download caching pattern applies: preconditions (repeated dependency fetching, cache input includes the dependency manifest) are met, and the experiment record experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2 demonstrates adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip keyed on hashFiles('pyproject.toml') with restore-keys. Adding the cache step after setup-python and before installation preserves all build/test coverage and permissions, installs the same packages, and only avoids re-downloading them. No fail-fast, timeout, or coverage changes are made, since fail-fast is intentionally false to run all matrix combinations.
